import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def get_color (t : Node) : Color :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c _ _ _ => c
  | Node.Empty => Color.Black -- Empty nodes are black

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def get_left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => some l | _ => none

def get_right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => some r | _ => none

def is_not_empty (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with | Node.Empty => False | _ => True

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_left_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  match t with
  | Node.Tree _ _ _ r =>
    -- Right child exists and is Red.
    -- (Dafny spec says Right is Red. Node itself can be any color).
    is_red r
  | _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def rotate_left (t : Node) 
    (h_precond : rotate_left_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr) =>
      Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr
  | other => other
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_left_postcond (t : Node) (result : Node)
    (_ : rotate_left_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  view result = view t ∧
  is_bst t → is_bst result ∧
  match result, t with
  | Node.Tree c' _ l' _, Node.Tree c _ _ r =>
      -- New root color matches old root color
      c' = c ∧
      -- New left child matches old root and is RED
      (match l' with
       | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => True
       | _ => False) ∧
      -- Black height preservation
      (black_height t ≠ -1 → black_height result = black_height t)
  | _, _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma view_rotate_left_eq
    (c : Color) (v rv : Int) (l rl rr : Node) :
    view (Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr) =
      view (Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr)) := by
  ext x
  simp [view]
  aesop

lemma is_bst_rotate_left
    (c : Color) (v rv : Int) (l rl rr : Node)
    (h : is_bst (Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr))) :
    is_bst (Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr) := by
  simp only [is_bst] at h ⊢
  rcases h with ⟨hlv, hbl, hrightv, hrlv, hbrl, hrrv, hbrr⟩
  have hv : v < rv :=
    hrightv rv (by simp [view])
  have hrlgt : ∀ x ∈ view rl, x > v := by
    intro x hx
    exact hrightv x (by simp [view, hx])
  refine ⟨?_, ⟨hlv, hbl, hrlgt, hbrl⟩, hrrv, hbrr⟩
  intro x hx
  simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  rcases hx with (hx | hx) | hx
  · exact lt_trans (hlv x hx) hv
  · exact hrlv x hx
  · subst x
    exact hv

lemma black_height_tree
    (c : Color) (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree c v l r) =
      if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧
          black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
          black_height l = black_height r then
        if c == Color.Black then black_height l + 1 else black_height l
      else
        -1 := by
  rfl

lemma black_height_red
    (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l r) =
      if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧
          black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
          black_height l = black_height r then
        black_height l
      else
        -1 := by
  rw [black_height_tree]
  have hred : (Color.Red == Color.Black) = false := by
    rfl
  rw [hred]
  simp

lemma black_height_rotate_left
    (c : Color) (v rv : Int) (l rl rr : Node)
    (h :
      black_height (Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr)) ≠ -1) :
    black_height (Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr) =
      black_height (Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr)) := by
  have hr :
      black_height rl ≠ -1 ∧
      black_height rr ≠ -1 ∧
      black_height rl = black_height rr := by
    by_contra hn
    have hright :
        black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr) = -1 := by
      rw [black_height_red]
      simp [hn]
    apply h
    rw [black_height_tree, hright]
    simp

  have hright :
      black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr) =
        black_height rl := by
    rw [black_height_red]
    simp [hr]

  have ho :
      black_height l ≠ -1 ∧
      black_height rl ≠ -1 ∧
      black_height l = black_height rl := by
    by_contra hn
    apply h
    rw [black_height_tree, hright]
    simp [hn]

  have hleft :
      black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) =
        black_height l := by
    rw [black_height_red]
    simp [ho]

  have hout :
      black_height l ≠ -1 ∧
      black_height rr ≠ -1 ∧
      black_height l = black_height rr := by
    exact ⟨ho.1, hr.2.1, ho.2.2.trans hr.2.2⟩

  calc
    black_height (Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr) =
        if black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) ≠ -1 ∧
            black_height rr ≠ -1 ∧
            black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) =
              black_height rr then
          if c == Color.Black then
            black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) + 1
          else
            black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl)
        else
          -1 := black_height_tree c rv
            (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr
    _ = if c == Color.Black then black_height l + 1
        else black_height l := by
      rw [hleft]
      simp [hout]
    _ = black_height
          (Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr)) := by
      rw [black_height_tree, hright]
      simp [ho]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem rotate_left_postcond_satisfied (t : Node)
    (h_precond : rotate_left_precond t) :
    rotate_left_postcond t (rotate_left t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
      simp [rotate_left_precond] at h_precond
  | Tree c v l r =>
      cases r with
      | Empty =>
          simp [rotate_left_precond, is_red] at h_precond
      | Tree rc rv rl rr =>
          cases rc with
          | Black =>
              simp [rotate_left_precond, is_red] at h_precond
          | Red =>
              dsimp [rotate_left_postcond, rotate_left]
              rintro ⟨_, hbst⟩
              refine
                ⟨is_bst_rotate_left c v rv l rl rr hbst,
                 rfl,
                 trivial,
                 ?_⟩
              exact black_height_rotate_left c v rv l rl rr
  -- !benchmark @end proof
